reviews.text: This is where you want your cat to stay. Truly a pawliday for your pet. They are so incredibly sweet and caring. You regularly receive photos or a video with an update. A wonderfully beautiful place! Highly recommended! My cat didn't even want to come along today, she had such a wonderful time.

We had to travel and leave our kitty behind in Amsterdam. Katwoman & Ko is simply incredible! They are so caring not just towards our pet but also go out of their way to ensure us with daily photos and footages of our kitty. Their kitty hotel looks like a theme park with additional outdoor space where the pets can spend all day if weather allows. They also have plenty space and treats to ease missing their families, and all that for a very reasonable price! We are so so thankful!

I honestly can't put it into words, but I'll try my best to describe my experience. I’m so happy that I chose to leave my little cat, Prinsje, with them while I was away. I was on vacation for three weeks, and they took such wonderful care of him.
They are incredibly kind and caring people. Every single day, they sent me videos and photos, and we stayed in touch through WhatsApp, which gave me so much peace of mind.
My little cat was so happy and content with them. I would definitely choose them again and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and loving cat hotel. You can truly see that they do this work with genuine love and passion.
Prinsje was so happy there that he didn’t even want to come home with me, haha!
Until next time!
Best wishes,
Ahlam

Truly an outstanding cat hotel and a wonderful experience for my cat! I left my Millie here for over a month, and for reference, I am a crazy helicopter cat-mom, so was very nervous as my cat hasn’t been around many other animals before. Devi and the hotel staff were so lovely and attentive with Millie, and with me lol. We got video and photo updates every single day, they made sure to let us know how she’s doing. My cat absolutely did not want to leave when we came to pick her up, she spent the whole month playing and making (and welcoming) new cat friends.

They also have strict check-in and check-out times that we couldn’t make, but they went above and beyond to accommodate us. I couldn’t be happier ❤️ thank you so much, from me and Millie. She will be back to stay with you again soon. 😊

Boef always feels at home at Katwomen Ko. He has been with Devi for several (5?) times already and is taken care of super well. We receive constant photo’s and videos and also when we collect him he looks happy and healthy. Our go-to place for a pawliday!

Dutch
I dare to leave my cat blindly with these lovely people with peace of mind. They are super sweet and patient and give a lot of attention. My cat enjoyed himself every time. Received nice photos and videos every day and are always available. If you really love your cat or cats, you can leave them with them with peace of mind.

English
I dare to leave my cat blindly with these lovely people with peace of mind. They are super sweet and patient and give a lot of attention. My cat had a good time every time. Receive nice photos and videos every day and are always available. If you really love your cat or cats, you can leave them with peace of mind.

French
J'ose laisser mon chat à l'aveugle avec ces gentils gens en toute tranquillité d'esprit. Ils sont super gentils et patients et accordent beaucoup d'attention. Mon chat s'est amusé à chaque fois. Receive the beautiful photos and videos of your day and son of yours available. Si vous aimez vraiment ou vos chats, vous pouvez les laisser avec eux en toute confiance.

The perfect place for my outdoor boy as they have a nice outdoor area. Love that they really get to know their cat guests on a personal level and I enjoy watching them on their Instagram. Everyone seems to genuinely care about cats even when my cat was being naughty 😅 We get pictures and videos regularly so I had zero worry during his 3 weeks 😻
Amazing place for cats! Highly recommended 👍✨ …

I could not be happier with a cat sitter than I am with Katwoman & Ko.

- They take care of your cat as if they where their own.
- You get updated daily, so I could tell that my cat enjoyed his time there.
- They are very clear in what to expect.
- The place looks amazing, clean and fun.
- The price is definitely worth it plus everyone is super friendly.

I would definitely recommend and will be back for our next holiday.
Great!
NEVER BRING YOUR CAT HERE TODAY, IT MAY HAVE TO BE STOLEN BECAUSE THEY ARE NOT TAKE PROPER CARE OF THE CATS
Disco has been visiting since he was a kitten and I would not want him to stay anywhere else. Devi and the team are caring, loving and thoughtful towards every cat they care for

Lotje had a wonderful stay at Katwoman.
She received lots of attention, everything was clean and well cared for, and she was able to go outside. We left her with complete peace of mind and picked up a relaxed, happy cat. Katwoman is definitely a regular address for Lotje. Highly recommended!
Great service! happy to leave my cat here whenever I’m out of town.

Our cat Tina has vacationed @Katwoman & Co 3 or 4 times already and we are coming back again over the end of the year holiday!
She is extremely well taken care of there, has a lot of space to play, relax, sleep, eat or even go outside in a protected area. She gets brushed, fed and hugs on a daily basis. And we get photos and videos of her almost everyday so we know she’s ok.
Hands down the best kat hotel in town!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Katwoman is simply outstanding! Every stay is excellent!
Quinoto is cared for with so much love and has a blast with his feline friends. And for us purrents, the daily updates make missing him so much easier. Truly the best experience, every time. 🐾 …

Always a good time when our cat goes to Katwoman and Ko!
We take him for longer stays and he settled in easily with the other cats :)

Our Ragdoll Frankie has had two stays and has been so happy! We get daily pictures and updates and she gets expert attention and care. She is well fed and socialised and if anything worrying comes up a vet is called and dealt with. We are able to go away with absolutely peace of mind.
Very good cat hotel, quite spacious and with a lot of places for cats to climb and play!

We have left our cat there a few times, and every time it went great. Devi and her colleagues take great care of the cats, the animals have lots of space inside and outside and play and rest.
The communication is very smooth, before, during and even after the stay.
Highly recommend!
We have been bringing our cats to Devi over the last few years, and we keep coming back as she takes great care of them!

This is the best place for Cats im Amsterdam, they have lots of space, playopportunities and even the possibility to get outside. Our Cat enjoyed his purrfect Pawlidays 5 times already and he always loved it. We also really appreciate the fotos and Videos we get during the whole time.

We have left our cat here several times and are very pleased with their service, you can tell they care about the cats and they make sure to send pictures and videos while you are away which is very appreciated

Rocky really enjoyed her stay here.
I like how they ask for all the vaccination documents and evidence to ensure the safety of our fur babies.
She is going back in December and I hope she enjoys her stay again.
They also keep sending you pics and videos and they also respond in timely manner ❤️❤️
My cat had an amazing experience here. She came back healthy and happy! It didnt seem like she missed me at all. The service provided is very strong and I would certainly use them again.

My cat Indy has stayed with Katwoman and Ko 4x times now and always wants to come back! It’s always hard leaving your babies behind when going abroad, but I always know that she is in good hands here. Your cat gets a full holiday too! The staff are wonderful, caring and send me pictures and videos regularly. The facilities are amazing with lots to explore as well as with places to withdraw for a good catnap. Sometimes I’m worried Indy won’t want to come home 😆. She is already looking forward to her next stay!

Had a really good experience. Tigre had a wonderful time, and I received a photo or video every day. This really gives you peace of mind when you leave your cat somewhere and know that everything is going well! Highly recommended!
Amazing people and place! Our cat is always taken care of and has a lot of fun!

Devis' cat hotel has become our trusted place for Mia whenever we are out of town. The space is modern, clean and thoughtfully designed for the cats to rest, play or socialize as they wish.

Devi and her team are very attentive, both with the cats and their owners. The daily updates make all the difference to us, giving peace of mind that Mia is well cared for and enjoying her stay <3

I couldn’t recommend this cat hotel enough, their service they provide is exceptional. They have been looking after my 3 cats for 3 months, send me daily updates and videos, very personal contact. I have a very close bond with my cats and choosing this cat hotel allowed me to have no worries about them being well taken care of. Would always come here again 🙏🏻

I felt completely at ease leaving my cats here all summer. The place was very clean, and the staff sent me photos and kept me updated the whole time, which was such a relief. When I picked them up, they were happy, healthy, and clearly very well cared for. Highly recommend!

The cat hotel is awesome and my cat is always well taken care of. Lots of space  to play and to hide and even the possibility to go outside. They give a daily update and I would bring my cat any time and recommend to everyone. 👌🏼😸 …

Our Lou spends all our holidays with Devi and her team. We could not be happier with the care and love she gets there. They send us daily pics and movies to keep us posted & we can truly see that Lou is at home there. We could not be happier with Devi and her team. They give us peace of mind while we’re on holiday. Can highly recommend her place.

We have left our cat here 3 times already and we only have good words for Katwoman & Co. It is a great place for cats to socialize with other cats while their humans are away.  They also send you pictures and videos everyday which makes being away from them easier.
Here you can enjoy your holidays knowing your cat is being taken good care of.

Joris has been here about 5 times now, one time he didn't even want to come back. Devi and her team are super nice to him, and I can see that he is enjoying himself. 😃 It is nice to know that he is always in good hands here. …

The nicest and best cat sitter ever!
Daily updates and fun photos and videos of our cat Jip. You can tell they would do anything for the cats and only go for the best.
The outdoor enclosure is also safely fenced off, and there are plenty of toys and soft beds inside.

Devi and her team are highly recommended ❤️
See you next year!

I've been sending my cat to Devi for the last few years, and I'm always impressed at her amazing knowledge of cat behaviour, the measures taken to make sure they're safe and happy and the amount of updates I get everyday. I have quite a skittish and nervous cat, and Devi takes amazing care of her and she always settles in nicely. Highly recommend!

Katwoman and Ko Amsterdam is an amazing cat hotel. You can leave your cats here when you travel or go to work as they are individually given the love and attention they need. Since there are no cages, the cats have the freedom to move around the outside space as well.  We noted that they had a lot of natural light through the large windows and the huge catio had many cats sunbathing!

The whole area has been thoughtfully designed keeping in mind the cat's natural instinct and behaviors. The cats settle in fast and they have room to sleep like a baby as well as play on the customized furniture that has been fastened to the walls as well as the ceiling!

We are surprised at the lack of any smell which was then explained to us was due to the automatic litter boxes that clean shortly after the cats had used them. We were also informed of the daily deep cleaning schedule the team follows and were impressed at their attention to detail.

Pur boy Captain Loki stayed at this hotel for 1 week and lost 500 grams which the vet told me is absolutely not normal. Ontop of that he came home with with very serious diarrhea and sickness which I had him to the  vets with 4 times in 1 week. The hotel smelt very nasty in arrival which is easily avoided, clearing all litter trays immediately eliminates any orders, this smell was so putrid it almost made you sick.  When we picked him up he looked terrified and had a huge scratch across his nose which they claim was from some kittens. I know this is an absolute lie, there wS a very aggressive white car staying there which im certain caused this. They did not seem to care for Loki and when we came to collect him they was both acting very suspicious and dodgy.  All videos and photos sent to ne he looked terrified and unhappy.  I dont think anyone bothered with him. Needless to say he will not be staying there again.  There was no care for the cats,the hotel stank and loki was very ill after staying with them.  I would not advise anyone leave there fur baby here. We will never again.

A wonderful place for your cat.
You can go on holiday with peace of mind.
We always come back.

We couldn’t be happier with Katwoman. Our cat Lío stays there regularly when we go on holiday and every time we are impressed. The team is super caring, attentive and genuinely loves the cats. They send us updates, photos and films of Lío which always puts a smile on our face. If something is wrong, like when he once didn’t want to eat, they notice right away and take action. It gives us complete peace of mind knowing he is in such good hands. A big recommendation with a purr and a smile.

We left our two cats at Katwoman & Co in Amsterdam and couldn’t be happier with the experience. The team truly cares, they kept us updated with regular photos and messages, which gave us complete peace of mind while we were away. Our cats came back relaxed, happy, and clearly well looked after. We’ll definitely bring them again. Highly recommended!

Devi and her team do an amazing job! I’ve been leaving my cat with them for a couple of years now and always know she’s well taken care of. The space is lovely, with a great outdoor area – highly recommended!
Great experience, very professional my cat had the best time of his life

Putting your pet in care because you’re going on holiday yourself is never easy, but here they really take great care of your beloved four-legged friend. Even though our cat needed some time to adjust, both at Katwoman&Ko and once she was back home, she was well looked after and the communication was fantastic. We received daily updates and even afterwards they checked in to see if everything was going well.
Wonderful environment, knowledgable and compassionate staff. A clean and safe place for your beloved cats. A professional and enjoyable experience for all concerned. Highly recommended !!

Great cat hotel. People are friendly, there are loads and loads of toys and places for your cat to hang out, as well as a massive enclosure outside for the cats to play. It’s our favorite cat hotel, we can thoroughly recommend it!

I definitely recommend katwoman & ko. We needed a cat sitter at short notice and they were the place to go. They are true cat lovers and made sure our cat felt at home quickly. We could go on vacation with peace of mind. We were kept updated every day with photos via WhatsApp. I really appreciate it and definitely recommend them.

Very happy with the excellent care of Katwoman & Ko. Our cat has stayed here twice and received outstanding care with genuine attention and dedication. The personal approach and communication provided complete peace of mind. Highly recommended.

We had bad experience with our Luna in this hotel some cat scratched my cat in the eye and her eye is infected . She get lesion in her left eye . They did anything they didn’t even checked temperature. First was right eye now it’s left . We never had those problems when we put our Luna in the hotel . In the beginning was sneezing . And last thing she lost 1.2 kg in 2 weeks this is not normal . I understand she was stressed but …… if you see some signs react ….happy cast doesn’t look like that. …..For that price we paid vet should be included …..trying to clean atmosphere they think calling us they will heal her….. and owner was saying she scratched herself….. our vet said something different……. In a place where is 20 or more cats just to earn money and don’t care well ….. doesn’t look good . Last picture shows her happy.

Good evening,

Please don’t leave your cat/s in this “hotel”, the worst experience for us and for our cat!
We were following this space on Instagram and TikTok for 2years, so we decided to book for our female cat, pay almost  400€ for her stay. The first visit, the space seemed max. 10m2, with a bit of covered balcony, the staff were very kind, but what we saw was almost 30cats in the same space, some up the “wood’tree”, some in the floor, and right in front of us one cat puked in the floor and the action taken was “hahaha it happens, they are cats” and no one cleaned, it stayed there even till we left the local,  but since it’s true that, because of their fur’balls, I thought that maybe it happens!
We went on vacation and during that time we received messages about her sneezing, even having the vaccine for it, and if we wanted them to take to the vet, but it would be more expensive, then the left eye seemed in the pictures that was infected and a bit swollen, so the owner told us she would start to put a cream in her eye, it passed a bit in the next pictures we received, but then the left was good and now would be the right eye, so it was in the time that we arrived and went to pick up our cat, immediately we took to the vet, where it was performed several exams. Strange that after we picked her up from the hotel and went to the vet, we received a lot of messages from Katwoman worried about our cat and if we needed any kind of help to search for vet/treatments!
In our cat’s vet  it was discovered a deep wound inside the eye made by other cat, which the response from the “hotel’owner” was that it was our cat that scratched and did on her own! But let’s continue with what the Vet discovered, she had a lot of fever, and in 2weeks our cat lost 1.20kg (remembering that the cat is expected to loose 200gr (max.) per 2weeks if in a diet)!
Now, one week already passed with the treatment applied everyday and the eye is even more swollen and today with blood drops in the floor, we opened her eye and the eye seems like a mirror so I hope that it is because of the treatment and not losing the vision!
Is perceptible in the pictures that it went from an healthy cat to a sad/depressed that is always hiding in dark places, sick and miserable cat!
If it is to have a cat’hotel, create conditions for them and not toys, create hygiene, create more divisions for the cats! Is so sad and disappointing for us that we had a star, and now we have damage in our “daughter”! Basically sell what you have, and not vain promises just to “feed” the eyes of the public!
I’m deeply sad!

Absolute lifesavers and true cat-lovers. We found them in a pinch, when we were still very new to the country and needed cat care on short notice, and now two years later, our cat goes to “cat camp” here whenever we’re out of town. Devi and her team truly adore cats, and we always feel well-updated; their professionalism and setup have grown over time, too. Our social (only) cat settles in fast in both directions and comes home extra soft somehow. Probably not a great fit if your cat is a cat-hater; would recommend to anyone else, even if it’s a bit of a pain to reach from Amsterdam proper. It’s worth it to us.

This place was incredible. They sent me videos and photos every day which was sooo welcome; sooo reassuring.  And they have a network of catwalks and hanging bowls which almost all pics was of my cat in a bowl, lol. Have to get a hanging bowl now! Just a lovely lovely place!

The best cat hotel I’ve ever trusted with my furry baby! They truly care about each cat’s wellbeing, which puts my mind at ease. I love getting regular updates with photos and videos, so I always know he’s happy and in good hands. Plus, they have a great patio where the cats can enjoy some fresh air!

Devi at Katwoman and Ko Amsterdam offers an amazing and unique service for looking after our cats, and comes highly recommended. we have used a lot of cat sitters over the years with our chaotic, international lifestyle and Devi offers by far the best and most personalised service. Our cats are treated as special guests, are super happy and come back home relaxed, well fed and sometimes wanting to stay! there are no cages, the cat guests have ample freedom inside and outside in the extensive catoooterie (outside area) and there are hundreds of knooks, crannies, window hammocks, comfortable beds, snuggly blankets and even ‘trees’ to explore, hide in and be secure in- there is something and somewhere for all cat personalities. she is super great with all fur babies, all the cats adore her, she has that special knack- i can only say, this unique and splendid cat palace is a welcome and safe place for our boys to stay, short or long term as suits. Definitely highly recommended. (shown here are our two boys, Alfie and Barry at home)
Beautiful place to bring your cat 🥰 …

I couldn’t recommend more. ❤️
The amazing team sent daily updates with information about our cats’ behavior, and photos during all the stay.
Responsible, organized and caring, we can feel (and check in person) the effort that they did to make the space into a great place for a cat’s vacation.
The indoors are filled with vertical spaces to the cat exercises and to be entertained. Also, there’s plenty of sun light through the big room. The outdoors is a fenced area, where they can enjoy the breeze when the weather allows it.
We feel safe on leaving our cats with Devi and her staff.

I was a little nervous leaving my two cats at a cat hotel for the first time, but my concerns were quickly allayed. Devi and her team at Katwoman & Ko Amsterdam were incredibly caring and attentive. The moment I dropped my cats off, I knew they were in good hands. Katwoman offers a room full of fun toys and climbing furniture where the cats can play and climb. The team sent me regular updates and photos, which was very reassuring! When I picked up my cats, they looked relaxed and happy. I would definitely recommend this cat hotel to anyone looking for a safe and loving place for their feline friends.

This is the second time that our Igor is staying at Devi’s. We always get pictures and update which we really appriciate. Devi thank you so much for the good care of our baby fur. By far the best cathotel it’s cat friendly and spacious.

Devi and her team, run an extremely professional cat hotel.

Our cat has been there on 4 different occassions now and each time, he was so …

Simply the best! Our cats needed accommodation very last minute and Katwoman welcomed them in the very next day! Great care! Daily updates via a dedicated group chat about our cat’s wellbeing with videos! Place looks great and cats hardly missed us!

A very homely place for cats and kittens. There is so much of love and care given to each and every cat at Katwoman & Ko and I really loved the fact that the cats had time to mingle among themselves which can even develop into strong …

Perfect experience at Katwoman & Ko. The place is very clean and it is obvious the team loves cats a lot.
Check in and check out is very easy and convenient. …

If you are looking for a cat sitter and a loving cat hotel for your cat, then rest assured you should choose Katwoman & Ko. Devi ensures the kitties feel absolutely at home with love, attention, playtime, and timely meals. Exactly what our …
Devi’s the best nanny ever!!! Always taking such a good care, sending lots of pictures, communicating for everything. I will always pick her as my kitties nanny. Trust her completely 🩷 …
